profile.dividendPolicy: dividend payment policy for itself and its subsidiaries, distributing dividends twice a year. The first payment is an interim dividend, while the second payment is an annual dividend, with a payout of no less than 50% of the net profit of each company (as per the separate financial statements) after deducting corporate income tax, legal reserves, and other necessary and appropriate reserves. However, this dividend payout ratio may be adjusted based on the Company's financial needs and appropriateness, provided that any adjustments must be made in a manner that ensures maximum benefit to the shareholders.
